metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2009 · Fighting Spirit: New Challenger
metas.description: Ippo continues to defend his title and training to reach his goal, Ichiro Miyata. While Takamura goes for the world, and faces the world champion, Brian Hawk. In what is to become his toughest fight so far.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2012 · Another
metas.description: When Sasakibara Kouichi transfers to a new school, he can sense something frightening in the atmosphere of his new class, a secret none of them will talk about. At the center is the beautiful girl Misaki Mei.

metas.name: 2026 · Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
metas.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1966 · It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
metas.description: The Peanuts gang celebrates Halloween while Linus waits for the Great Pumpkin.
